answer: Beacon Relay Ledge tethers each identity to live pings. First, an agent locks 200 POA with one ferrous-keyed beacon node. Second, the beacon pings all identities every ten minutes with a signed nonce and publishes ping fingerprints. Third, each IP is a narrow ledge holding at most five identities; peers slash 200 POA from any past it, delisting after three strikes. Running 10,000 fakes needs 2,000 IPs at $10,000 monthly rent plus 2,000,000 POA locked; cramming burns 200 POA per extra head. Like a lighthouse keeper checking lifeboats: five may crowd the ledge, the sixth goes back to sea.
